description: From-scratch SLURM scripts and login-node helpers (design sections 6, 7, 8, tests 11.5): slurm/r_level4.sh (one-run level 4 from scratch with delayed deform start; two-stage fallback documented), slurm/r_level2.sh and slurm/r_level1.sh (cascade retrains reusing the m8/m9 recipes with the per-stage skip schedule), slurm/sweep_level4.py (phases A lr x wd, B group sizes, C iterations; two-active-jobs rule; qtim only) and scripts/summarize_runs.py (stdlib ranking + length_decision), plus tests/test_sweep_tools.py and run_tests_wsl.sh hooks. Includes the binding fixes of design review v1.3 (findings 1, 3, 4, 5, 6). Depends on FEAT-001..004 and FEAT-007 (the scripts pass --optimizer adamw, --lowres-method tent, --cascade-skip-*, --task-start-step, --max-pairs; the dry-run tests only check argument text, but main.py must accept every flag). Design section 16 (addendum) overrides section 6 where they differ: MAX_PAIRS default 64 in all three scripts, PAIR_RECOMPUTE default false at levels 4 and 2.
steps: slurm/r_level4.sh, slurm/r_level2.sh, slurm/r_level1.sh (new; copy structure from slurm/m9_level1_cascade.sh; m7/m8/m9 scripts unchanged): #SBATCH -A qtim -p rtx8000 --gpus=1 -N 1 --ntasks-per-node=1 --cpus-per-task=3 --mem=64G, --output/--error under /autofs/space/crater_001/users/jn85/BrainRegProjects/GroupwiseReg/logs/%x-%j.{out,err}, --time 24:00:00 / 24:00:00 / 60:00:00; same container, binds, TMPDIR/KERAS_HOME/CUDA_CACHE_PATH exports and `repo rev` print as m9. Recipe exactly per design section 6: hard-coded --amp true --split-group-conv true --intensity-aug-device tf; env LOWRES_METHOD (default tent), OPTIMIZER (adamw|adam, default adamw), LR, WD (default 0), --schedule cosine --warmup-steps $WARMUP --min-lr-factor 1e-3 --ckpt-every $CKPT_EVERY (250), GRAD_BALANCE gradnorm -> --task-grad-norm 12 | deform64 -> --task-loss-weights deform:64, explicit deform lambdas (--lambda-dice-template 1 --lambda-pdice 1 --lambda-ncc-template 1 --lambda-ncc-pair 1 --lambda-smooth 0.5 --p-pdice 0.1, in DEFORM_ARGS only when HAS_DEFORM) and --p-pair 0.1, --min-pairs $MIN_PAIRS, --log-every 25 --log-backend jsonl --val-png true --num-threads ${SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK:-3}, VAL_ARGS (--val-group-size when VAL_GROUP_SIZE non-empty, integer >= 2), TASKS / HAS_DEFORM / HAS_LINEAR derivation, TASK_RATIO regex validation, memory-knob rules (GRAD_CKPT none|integrator|decoder|both|full default full; PAIR_RECOMPUTE true; MIN_PAIRS n; LEAN_LOSSES false/false/true; with deform and GRAD_CKPT != none: --gradient-checkpointing $GRAD_CKPT --lean-sampler true --pair-recompute $PAIR_RECOMPUTE [+ --lean-losses true]; GRAD_CKPT=none: only --gradient-checkpointing none with the NOTE line; linear-only: --gradient-checkpointing none + NOTE), MEM_ARGS from TF_MEM_LIMIT_MB (0 = growth; defaults 0 / 0 / 40000), EXTRA_ARGS last, numeric/enum env validation with exit 2, BGR_DRY_RUN=1 prints `MAIN: python main.py ...` and `CHECK: python tests/gpu/check_mixed_run.py ...` and exits 0 before any mkdir / write / singularity (CASCADE_FROM guard still runs read-only). Checker line per design section 6 (--tasks "$TASKS" --steps "$STEPS" --expect-min-pairs "$MIN_PAIRS" --max-nonfinite-frac 0.06 --memory-budget-mb 36864 --project-steps --project-val-every --expect-enc-grad true $BALANCE_CHECK $LEVEL_CHECK_ARGS); exit code main.py's if non-zero else the checker's.

r_level4.sh specifics (design table + 5.1): defaults RUN_NAME r4_<job>, STEPS 16000, VAL_EVERY 500, WARMUP 1000, LR 3e-4, N / DEFORM_N placeholders 64 / 32 each with `# TODO(m10 memory job): from record "<name>" (knobs: <knob set>)`, TASK_RATIO rigid:1,affine:1,deform:2, DEFORM_START 3000, DEFORM_RAMP 500, CURRICULUM true + CURRICULUM_RAMP 3000 (ramp flag only when true), G_START 3000, G_RAMP 3000, G_ROT 45, G_TRANS 10 (--global-transform true ...), VAL_PAIR_CHUNK 16, VAL_GROUP_SIZE 16, DEFORM_DECODER auto, INIT optional (existing dir -> --init-weights, else exit 2; checker --expect-init-weights full, else none). REVIEW v1.3 NIT 3 (binding): pass --task-start-step deform:$DEFORM_START --task-start-ramp-steps $DEFORM_RAMP only when HAS_DEFORM && HAS_LINEAR && DEFORM_START > 0; with a deform-only ratio print `NOTE: deform-only ratio, DEFORM_START ignored`. BALANCE_CHECK = --grad-balance-rule true --grad-balance-from-step $((DEFORM_START + 100)) when the task-start flags are passed, 100 when deform+linear without them, empty otherwise. Header: two-stage fallback commands verbatim (design 6 'Header extras'), the step-3000 dip note, smoke + long commands, 'DO NOT submit without Jay's approval; at most two active jobs (squeue -u jn85)'.

r_level2.sh / r_level1.sh specifics: CASCADE_FROM required on a fresh run (exit 2; guard skipped when $RESULTS/$RUN_NAME/ckpt/last/checkpoint exists), --level 2 / --level 1, BN_RECAL_BATCHES 64 (freeze true), --cascade-skip-linear "$SKIP_LINEAR" --cascade-skip-deform "$SKIP_DEFORM" (level 2: 4:0 / 4:0.15; level 1: 4:0,2:0.15 / 4:0.15,2:0.15), G from 0, curriculum off at level 2 (as m8), level-1 extras as m9 (N 8 int32 note, DEFORM_N 4, LEAN_LOSSES true, TF_MEM_LIMIT_MB 40000 (A100 34000), VAL_IMAGE_CHUNK 1, VAL_PAIR_CHUNK 1, BN_RECAL_VALIDATE false), level-2 VAL_PAIR_CHUNK 4, VAL_GROUP_SIZE empty; checker --expect-cascade true --expect-skip true --expect-init-weights full (+ --expect-cascade-stages 2 at level 1, --expect-bn-recal true when BN_RECAL_BATCHES > 0). r_level1 header: compare smoke gpu_peak with m9's 36.7 GB; MIN_PAIRS=1 fallback above 39000 MB.

REVIEW v1.3 FINDING 1 (MEDIUM, binding text in the r_level4 and r_level2 headers, and replacing every 'peak <= 46000 MB' mention): define `fits(record, partition) := record.peak_mb <= BUDGET[partition][level]` with BUDGET.rtx8000 = {4: 42000, 2: 41000} and BUDGET.dgx-a100 = 34000 at every level, unit = MiB as written by tests/gpu/measure_level_memory.py (MB = 2**20) into scratch/m10/memory_batch.json `peak_mb`; budget derivation 46080 MiB - 500 context - DALI (~1000 at L4, ~2000 at L2 with TF aug) - 1024 headroom - ~1500 validation/fragmentation gap (m9). N / DEFORM_N = the largest measured N with fits, from the record whose knob set equals the script defaults; GRAD_CKPT=none allowed only if the no-ckpt record fits at the chosen DEFORM_N; the smoke (>= 2 validations) must show INFO gpu_peak <= the same budget, else drop to the next measured N; TF_MEM_LIMIT_MB=0 (growth) kept at levels 4/2 because DALI is small there, first fallback after a post-validation OOM is TF_MEM_LIMIT_MB=<budget>. REVIEW NIT 5: r_level2 / r_level4 headers state 'set --time from the smoke's INFO step_time projection x 1.3; if it exceeds the limit, resubmit with the same RUN_NAME (resumable)'.

slurm/sweep_level4.py (new, stdlib only, Python 3.6 syntax, no dataclasses/capture_output/text=/fromisoformat/f-string '='): subcommands list / status / submit with the grid options of design 7.2; configs per 7.1 (phase A 9 runs wd-major with wd 0 first and lr order 3e-4, 1e-4, 1e-3; phase B 2 runs; phase C STEPS 12000 / 16000 with the final schedule); fmt() rules; run names r4sw_

_lr.._wd.._n.._d.. and r4sw_C_s_...; job names r4sw with one global index A 0-8, B 9-10, C 11-12; full cfg_env set; SCRIPT_ENV_KEYS constant; job_env(); status states running/pending/done/failed/not started. REVIEW NIT 4 (binding): a config with a /r4sw_submissions.jsonl record for its run name that is neither in squeue nor has a run dir is **failed ('died before start')** and never resubmitted automatically. submit: --max-active 1|2 (else exit 2), active = all squeue -h -u lines, dirty-tree refusal (git status --porcelain non-empty -> exit 2), rev recorded, list-form subprocess.check_output(['sbatch', '--parsable', '-A', 'qtim', '-p', partition, '--job-name', name, '--time', time, '--mem', '64G', 'slurm/r_level4.sh'], env=..., cwd=repo), jsonl append {time, job_id, run, rev, env}, partition rtx8000|dgx-a100 (+ --a100-ok), errors per design 10. REVIEW NIT 6 (binding): VAL_GROUP_SIZE default = min(16, DEFORM_N_small) fixed for the whole sweep and recorded in every cfg_env (with the default grid this is 16). REVIEW NIT 5: help text of --c-time = 'derive from the phase-A INFO step_time'.

scripts/summarize_runs.py (new, stdlib only, Python 3.6): CLI and columns per design section 8; ranking + exclusions + 'final = last record containing the key' per 7.3; val_group_size guard (ERROR + unranked, exit 0); rev column from r4sw_submissions.jsonl + mixed-rev WARNING; --csv; --length-curve RUN8,RUN12,RUN16 with pure function length_decision(points, tol_l=0.05, tol_dp=0.003) returning 8000/12000/16000, 20000 (new run command printed) or 'UNDECIDED (<reason>)'; exit 2 only when results_root does not exist.

tests/test_sweep_tools.py (new, TF-free, no TF import): cases 11.5 a-h of the design, plus: (b/c) the 'died before start' failed state (jsonl record, no run dir, not in squeue -> failed, not resubmitted); (h) r_level4 TASK_RATIO=deform:1 dry run has no --task-start-step and no --grad-balance-rule and prints the NOTE; VAL_GROUP_SIZE in cfg_env == min(16, deform_n_small). Use temp dirs with fake squeue/sbatch/git scripts first on PATH (pattern: tests/test_slurm_scripts.py TestStubRuns), skip bash cases when bash is missing. Add the three new scripts to tests/test_slurm_scripts.py TestStatic header checks only if cheap; otherwise keep them in test_sweep_tools.

DESIGN SECTION 16 (Jay, binding, overrides the PAIR_RECOMPUTE default above): all three scripts get env MAX_PAIRS (default 64 = the validation cap; integer >= 0, else exit 2) -> common main.py flag --max-pairs $MAX_PAIRS (FEAT-007). PAIR_RECOMPUTE default false in r_level4.sh and r_level2.sh, true in r_level1.sh only; header note: --pair-recompute unrolls one block per pair, a level-4 N 48 config (226 pairs) sat in graph construction ~2 h in job 10519650, so it is a level-1 option. Dry-run expectations (11.5 h) change accordingly: r_level4 default and r_level2 lines contain --pair-recompute false, r_level1 --pair-recompute true, all three --max-pairs 64; the m10 placeholder comment names a record measured without pair recompute at levels 4/2 (or states that a re-measurement is needed).

tests/run_tests_wsl.sh: add slurm/sweep_level4.py scripts/summarize_runs.py to PYFILES, slurm/r_level4.sh slurm/r_level2.sh slurm/r_level1.sh to the bash -n loop, tests.test_sweep_tools to the TF-free test list, and an ast.parse(feature_version=(3, 6)) check for the two helpers.
acceptance_criteria: bash -n passes for the three new scripts; every BGR_DRY_RUN case of design 11.5 h (plus the deform-only NIT 3 case) prints the expected MAIN/CHECK lines
tests.test_sweep_tools and tests.test_slurm_scripts pass in bgr_preproc38 without importing TensorFlow
sweep_level4.py and summarize_runs.py parse with ast feature_version=(3, 6) and contain none of capture_output, text=True, import dataclasses, from dataclasses, fromisoformat
No script or helper ever uses an account other than qtim; --max-active > 2 rejected; failed (incl. died-before-start) configs never resubmitted
Every main.py flag emitted by a dry run is accepted by runtime/args.py parse_args (check one assembled level-4 line with parse_args in a test, replacing --data with a dummy path if needed)
verification: WSL bgr_preproc38: bash -n slurm/r_level4.sh slurm/r_level2.sh slurm/r_level1.sh
WSL bgr_preproc38: python -m unittest tests.test_sweep_tools tests.test_slurm_scripts -v -> OK, and python -c 'import sys; import tests.test_sweep_tools; assert "tensorflow" not in sys.modules'
WSL bgr_preproc38: python slurm/sweep_level4.py list --phase A && python scripts/summarize_runs.py <synthetic results dir from the test fixtures> (spot check output)
findings: DONE (no git, no cluster). New: slurm/r_level4.sh, slurm/r_level2.sh, slurm/r_level1.sh, slurm/sweep_level4.py, scripts/summarize_runs.py, tests/test_sweep_tools.py; tests/run_tests_wsl.sh: helpers in PYFILES + new PY36FILES ast feature_version=(3, 6) check, three scripts in the bash -n loop, tests.test_sweep_tools in the TF-free list. m7/m8/m9 scripts and tests/test_slurm_scripts.py unchanged (TestStatic asserts no --val-group-size, so the new scripts are checked in test_sweep_tools instead). VERIFICATION (WSL bgr_preproc38, Python 3.8.20, bash 5.0.17): bash -n on the three scripts OK; py_compile + ast (3, 6) for both helpers and (3, 8) for all new Python OK; `python -m unittest tests.test_sweep_tools tests.test_slurm_scripts -v` -> Ran 58 tests OK (skipped=1); `import tests.test_sweep_tools` leaves tensorflow out of sys.modules; `python slurm/sweep_level4.py list --phase A` prints the 9 configs (wd 0 first, lr 3e-4/1e-4/1e-3, r4sw0-8, VAL_GROUP_SIZE=16, sbatch -A qtim -p rtx8000); summarize_runs spot check on a synthetic 3-run tree ranks correctly (folding run marked X, malformed line counted on stderr). Goldens not touched (no model / runtime code changed). Full suite not run (integration step). DESIGN POINTS: dry-run lines of r_level4 default / linear-only stage 1 / stage 2 / deform-only / GRAD_CKPT=none, r_level2 and r_level1 defaults are all parsed by runtime.args.parse_args in the tests (acceptance criterion) - with --max-pairs stripped, because FEAT-007 (--max-pairs) is still pending; TestMaxPairsFlag is skipped until runtime/args.py knows the flag and then runs automatically (check_parses also stops stripping). Review v1.3 fixes: finding 1 (fits/BUDGET rule, MiB unit = measure_level_memory MB = 2**20, derivation, smoke budget check, growth kept at L4/L2 + TF_MEM_LIMIT_MB=<budget> fallback, no '46000' anywhere) in r_level4 + r_level2 headers; NIT 3 (task-start flags only with deform AND linear AND DEFORM_START > 0, NOTE otherwise, tested); NIT 4 (died before start = failed, never resubmitted, tested in status + submit); NIT 5 (time rule in r_level4/r_level2/r_level1 headers, --c-time help); NIT 6 (VAL_GROUP_SIZE = min(16, DEFORM_N_small) in every cfg_env, tested with --deform-n 24 -> 12). Section 16: MAX_PAIRS 64 in all three (int >= 0), PAIR_RECOMPUTE false at L4/L2, true at L1, header note on job 10519650. SMALL DEVIATIONS (documented in the headers): (a) deform-only TASK_RATIO also drops curriculum and G (passes --curriculum false --global-transform false + NOTE), because parse_args rejects --curriculum/--global-transform without a linear task (same class of bug as NIT 3); (b) new envs PROJECT_STEPS / PROJECT_VAL_EVERY (default STEPS / VAL_EVERY, as the design's checker line) so the smoke commands in the headers project the long run (PROJECT_STEPS=16000 / 8000, PROJECT_VAL_EVERY=500); both are in SCRIPT_ENV_KEYS; (c) --expect-skip is passed at L2/L1 only when a trained task has a skip p > 0 (a linear-only L2 run with SKIP_LINEAR 4:0 logs no skip key and the checker's legacy fallback would fail); (d) SCRIPT_ENV_KEYS also lists PROJ, REPO, DATA, RESULTS, SIF, SCRATCH_ROOT, SLURM_JOB_ID, SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK, because the 11.5 g drift test's regex finds every ${NAME:- in r_level4.sh (sbatch sets the SLURM_* ones inside the job anyway); (e) VAL_GROUP_SIZE at L4 uses ${VAL_GROUP_SIZE-16} (set-but-empty = main.py default), SKIP_LINEAR/SKIP_DEFORM use ${X-default} (empty = all 0); (f) BN_RECAL_FREEZE env added at L2/L1 (as m8/m9); L1 passes --val-image-chunk inside the deform args; (g) sweep 'done' = the last record holding val/mean_pair_rms_mm has step == args.steps (robust to events like val_png_failed logged after the final validation); squeue is queried as `squeue -h -u <user> -o '%j %T'` once for both the active count and the states; submit --dry-run also reads squeue (read-only) to pick the configs. N / DEFORM_N are marked `# TODO(m10 memory job)` placeholders (L4 64/32 from 'L4 linear' / 'L4 deform knobs', L2 32/16 from 'L2 linear' / 'L2 deform knobs', all needing the capped re-measurement slurm/m10_batch_memory_capped.sh; L1 8 = int32 limit, 4 = m9, record 'L1 deform N5 lean'). FOLLOW-UP for FEAT-007 / orchestrator: tests/gpu/check_mixed_run.py --expect-min-pairs n computes expected_pairs without a cap, so with --max-pairs 64 at N 64 (403 -> 64 pairs) the checker's n_pairs check would FAIL on the cluster unless FEAT-007 teaches it the cap (config.json args.max_pairs). Not verifiable locally: login-node python3 version (no 3.6 interpreter locally; only ast feature_version + token check), real sbatch/squeue behaviour, cluster bash version (scripts use arrays and [[ =~ ]], fine on bash >= 4).
